function cySearch(list, q){
  q = (q || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return [];
  return list.filter(function(x){
    return x.w.indexOf(q) >= 0 || (x.p && x.p.indexOf(q) >= 0) || (x.m && x.m.indexOf(q) >= 0);
  });
}
function cyChain(list, word){
  if (!word) return [];
  var last = word.charAt(word.length - 1);
  return list.filter(function(x){ return x.w.charAt(0) === last; });
}
function cyFirstChar(list, ch){
  return list.filter(function(x){ return x.w.charAt(0) === ch; });
}
var EXPORTS = { CHENGYU: CHENGYU, search: cySearch, chain: cyChain, firstChar: cyFirstChar };

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) { module.exports = EXPORTS; }
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.ChengyuForgePure = EXPORTS; }
